description: Replaces the stock FS-20 Vortex's fly-by-wire with a modern flight control system, using the same control laws as my other FCS mods, plus F-35B-style STOVL control laws. CTOL: carefree handling and full authority control across the entire envelope, high resistance to departure on a damaged airframe, asymmetric loadout compensation and fuel balancing. STOVL: speed-lever throttle with a zero-ground-speed detent, translational rate command in the hover (released stick holds the spot and the height), limits based on the authority the jet has, lift-fan thrust vanes, and a weapon release guard for asymmetric loads. Multiplayer: the flight-model changes only apply when the host also runs the mod and has enabled it (HostAllowFcs / HostLockVariant); otherwise everyone flies the stock Vortex. Not compatible with the FS-20 Vortex Family mod, at least not yet. The optional dev plugin (separate release asset) exposes the tuning settings.
